description: Crude and standardised adjusted risk ratios of 'killed_or_serious' by person-level factor (CRSS motorcycle operators and passengers)
method: Crude: weighted rate and saturated survey logit; Survey-weighted logistic regression (pseudo-ML, ridge 0.01), Taylor-linearised variance (25 strata, 67 PSUs, t with 42 df); standardised predictive margins -> adjusted RR/RD. Model A = person covariates + PRE_CRASH; model B = A + crash type + number of vehicles. Flags: suppressed = n<30 or no events (event-free levels blanked); unstable = crude rate, level margin or reference margin RSE>30%.
